[IMP] payment_mercado_pago: support testing mode

Mercado Pago has no sandbox environment; testing instead uses separate production accounts flagged as test, served by a dedicated proxy. Add a test connection mode that routes proxy requests to the test proxy and drops the now-unused sandbox_init_point.

The flow becomes: pick a connection mode (Test or Enabled), then connect. Connecting while disabled is blocked, and the OAuth controller no longer forces the state to enabled so the chosen mode is kept. The pre-enable credentials constraint is dropped, as it would otherwise prevent selecting a mode before connecting.

Test and live use different accounts, so credentials are reset on any state change: nothing records which mode a stored token belongs to, so keeping it across a change could leak test credentials into live mode.
